import html # Template for the invitation. Placeholders are escaped before insertion. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def render_event_invitation( event_title: str, event_description: str, event_date: str, additional_notes: str ) -> str: """ Render a sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- event_title : str The title of the event. event_description : str Full description of the event (may contain line breaks). event_date : str The date of the event. additional_notes : str Any user‑provided notes about the event. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for rendering on a web page. Notes ----- All user supplied data is escaped with `html.escape` to avoid XSS and ensure the output is well‑formed HTML. The function does not perform any further validation of dates or content, as that is outside the scope of this rendering helper. """ # Escape all user supplied content to prevent injection attacks escaped_title = html.escape(event_title, quote=True) escaped_description = html.escape(event_description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") escaped_date = html.escape(event_date, quote=True) escaped_notes = html.escape(additional_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Format the invitation using the sanitized values return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=escaped_title, event_description=escaped_description, event_date=escaped_date, additional_notes=escaped_notes )
